visualStyle: Friendly non-childish stylized 3D public-information animation with warm morning daylight, believable materials, warm ivory, pale wood, deep teal and clean blue accents.

shots.startFrame: Empty dorm kitchen foreground with Mina entering from frame left carrying a tote of mixed household waste.
shots.mainAction: Mina stops at the preparation counter and looks between a clear bottle, stained container, food scraps, and battery with mild uncertainty.
shots.endFrame: Mina remains still, four waste objects separated on the counter, clean negative space above for an editorial title.
shots.narration: 한국에서 생활하다 보면, 쓰레기통 앞에서 한 번쯤 망설이게 됩니다.
shots.sfx: soft room tone and tote set-down
shots.transition: match cut from Mina's eye line to the objects

shots.startFrame: Left side shows one messy mixed pile; right side shows the same materials spaced apart on a clean surface.
shots.mainAction: A loose battery rolls toward the mixed pile and stops before touching it while the clean right side remains stable.
shots.endFrame: Battery isolated in foreground, mixed pile soft-focused behind, clean separated materials on the right.
shots.narration: 잘못 섞인 쓰레기는 재활용을 어렵게 하고, 건전지는 화재 위험도 높입니다.
shots.sfx: light battery roll and restrained warning tick
shots.transition: clean blue wipe into the four-principle overview

shots.startFrame: Four clean work zones on the counter, each holding one simple object and ample blank space.
shots.mainAction: Mina's open hand moves once from left to right above the four zones to introduce the sequence.
shots.endFrame: Four zones aligned horizontally, Mina's hand exits to frame right.
shots.narration: 기억할 것은 네 가지. 비우고, 헹구고, 분리하고, 섞지 않습니다.

shots.startFrame: Mina's two correct hands hold a plain clear bottle above the sink with a small amount of clear liquid inside.
shots.mainAction: She tilts the bottle once and empties the remaining liquid into the sink.
shots.endFrame: Bottle upright and visibly empty above the sink.
shots.narration: 첫째, 용기 속 남은 내용물을 완전히 비웁니다.

shots.startFrame: The same empty bottle rests under a gentle narrow stream of water in the sink.
shots.mainAction: Mina rotates the bottle a single half-turn while rinsing the inside.
shots.endFrame: Water stops and the clean bottle is held upside down to drain.
shots.narration: 둘째, 음식물과 이물질을 물로 깨끗이 헹굽니다.
shots.transition: cut on bottle rotation to label edge

shots.startFrame: One hand stabilizes the clean bottle; the other pinches the edge of a plain blue label.
shots.mainAction: Mina peels the label away in one smooth continuous motion.
shots.endFrame: Bare clear bottle on the right and removed label held separately on the left.
shots.narration: 셋째, 라벨과 뚜껑처럼 다른 재질은 떼어 냅니다.
shots.transition: straight cut to separated material groups

shots.startFrame: Clear bottle, blue label, metal can, and paper box are each in separate clean zones.
shots.mainAction: Mina places the final paper box into its own zone without touching the other materials.
shots.endFrame: Four distinct material groups with equal spacing.
shots.narration: 넷째, 종류가 다른 재활용품은 서로 섞지 않습니다.
shots.transition: match cut from clear bottle to PET close-up

shots.startFrame: A clean unlabeled clear bottle stands upright beside its white cap and removed blue label.
shots.mainAction: Mina compresses the bottle once with both hands, then replaces the cap.
shots.endFrame: Compressed capped bottle centered; label remains separate and fully visible.
shots.narration: 무색 페트병은 라벨과 내용물을 제거하고 헹군 뒤, 압착해 뚜껑을 닫아 배출합니다.
shots.sfx: soft plastic compress and cap click
shots.transition: cut from clean bottle to stained container

shots.startFrame: A square translucent delivery container has one visible food stain in a corner.
shots.mainAction: Mina wipes and rinses once; a faint stain remains, so she moves the container away from the clean recycling group.
shots.endFrame: Questionable container isolated on a neutral tray, clean recyclables remain separate in background.
shots.narration: 배달용기처럼 오염된 플라스틱은 깨끗이 씻습니다. 지워지지 않으면 재활용품에 섞지 마세요.
shots.transition: shape match from container to food-waste bowl

shots.startFrame: A small strainer contains rice and soft vegetable scraps above a bowl; no bones or shells.
shots.mainAction: Water drains from the food scraps, then Mina transfers them into a plain dedicated food-waste container.
shots.endFrame: Drained food scraps inside the dedicated container, surrounding counter dry and clean.
shots.narration: 음식물쓰레기는 수분과 이물질을 줄이고, 지역의 전용봉투나 알 에프 아이 디 수거함을 이용합니다.

shots.startFrame: Two clean chicken bones and two shellfish shells rest on a small neutral tray beside the food-waste container.
shots.mainAction: Mina slides the tray away from the food-waste container toward a separate general-waste area.
shots.endFrame: Bones and shells clearly isolated from food scraps.
shots.narration: 하지만 닭뼈와 조개껍데기는 음식물이 아닙니다. 일반 종량제봉투로 배출합니다.

shots.camera: slow lateral slide left to right
shots.startFrame: Mina stands at the blank three-opening collection wall holding a small tray with three AA batteries, one intact fluorescent lamp, and one small hair dryer on separate levels.
shots.mainAction: In a controlled montage, she places each item toward its matching physical opening; only one item moves at a time.
shots.endFrame: All three items are safely stored, Mina's hands empty, clear aisle visible.
shots.narration: 폐건전지는 전지 수거함에, 깨지지 않은 형광등은 형광등 수거함에, 소형가전은 지정 수거 지점에 배출합니다.

shots.startFrame: Left half contains a restrained messy mixed pile; right half contains clean separated material groups in front of blank bins.
shots.mainAction: The left half softly desaturates while the right half brightens and Mina places one clean bottle into the correct opening.
shots.endFrame: Clean right side dominates composition; Mina faces frame right with a confident restrained smile.
shots.narration: 이렇게 깨끗하게 분리하면 재활용품은 다시 자원으로 쓰일 가능성이 높아집니다.
shots.sfx: soft successful placement and light chime

shots.startFrame: Mina and three supporting students stand in the open campus foreground beside clean separated waste and a phone held below face level.
shots.mainAction: Mina gestures once toward the recycling station; the group walks together from left to right.
shots.endFrame: Four students and campus station form a balanced wide composition with clean sky space for the K-SORT end card.
shots.narration: 세부 방법은 지역마다 다를 수 있습니다. 케이 소트로 확인하고, 오늘부터 정확하게 실천해 보세요.
shots.sfx: campus ambience and gentle resolved chime
shots.transition: hold final frame for one second
